description: Double-conserved synteny of the abhd10 ohnolog regions, the chr24 tagln3b/abhd10b gene-model merge with real Ensembl exon coordinates, and mitochondrial presequence features
code:
import json, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
N=json.load(open("neighbors.json"))
k5=[k for k in N if k=="abhd10a"][0]; k24=[k for k in N if k!="abhd10a"][0]
def fam(n):
    if not n or n=="None": return None
    m=re.match(r"^([a-z0-9\-\.]+?)([ab])$", n)
    return m.group(1) if m else None
f5={}; f24={}
for gid,nm,st in N[k5]:
    f=fam(nm)
    if f: f5.setdefault(f,[]).append((nm,int(st)))
for gid,nm,st in N[k24]:
    f=fam(nm)
    if f: f24.setdefault(f,[]).append((nm,int(st)))
shared=sorted(set(f5)&set(f24))
print("Gene families with an 'a' copy near abhd10a (chr5) and a 'b' copy near abhd10b (chr24):")
rows=[]
for f in shared:
    a=[x for x in f5[f] if x[0].endswith("a")]; b=[x for x in f24[f] if x[0].endswith("b")]
    if a and b:
        rows.append((f,a[0][0],a[0][1],b[0][0],b[0][1]))
        print("   %-8s  chr5 %-10s @ %d     chr24 %-10s @ %d"%(f,a[0][0],a[0][1],b[0][0],b[0][1]))
syn=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["family","chr5_gene","chr5_start","chr24_gene","chr24_start"])
syn.to_csv("ohnolog_synteny.csv",index=False)
print("\nn double-conserved syntenic families in +/-1.2 Mb:",len(syn))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(17,4.8))
# ---- Panel A: double-conserved synteny ----
ax=axes[0]
for i,r in syn.iterrows():
    ax.plot([0,1],[i,i],color="#8c8c8c",lw=1,zorder=1)
    ax.scatter([0],[i],s=40,color="#4c72b0",zorder=2); ax.scatter([1],[i],s=40,color="#dd8452",zorder=2)
    ax.text(-0.04,i,r.chr5_gene,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
    ax.text(1.04,i,r.chr24_gene,ha="left",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-0.55,1.55); ax.set_ylim(-0.8,len(syn)-0.2); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["chr5\n(abhd10a region)","chr24\n(abhd10b region)"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_title("A  Double-conserved synteny confirms\nthe abhd10 pair as TGD ohnologs",fontsize=10)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---- Panel B: the chr24 gene-model merge, real Ensembl coordinates ----
ax=axes[1]
tx={"tagln3b-204 (transgelin, 199 aa)":[(21917012,21918180),(21918294,21918396),(21920821,21920995),(21921083,21921289)],
    "tagln3b-203 (transgelin, 228 aa)":[(21917012,21918180),(21918294,21918396),(21920821,21921262)],
    "tagln3b-202 (transgelin, 199 aa)":[(21917211,21918180),(21918294,21918396),(21920821,21920995),(21921083,21921289),(21923864,21923930)],
    "tagln3b-201 = ABHD10 protein E7F9Y7 (289 aa)":[(21923348,21927796),(21928212,21928349),(21929047,21929158),(21931756,21931939),(21934090,21934571)]}
colors=["#4c72b0"]*3+["#c44e52"]
for i,(k,ex) in enumerate(tx.items()):
    y=len(tx)-i
    ax.plot([min(e[0] for e in ex),max(e[1] for e in ex)],[y,y],color=colors[i],lw=1)
    for a,b in ex: ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a,y-0.22),b-a,0.44,color=colors[i]))
    ax.text(21916500,y+0.33,k,fontsize=8,color=colors[i])
ax.set_ylim(0.2,len(tx)+1.1); ax.set_xlim(21916400,21935200)
ax.set_xlabel("chr24 position (GRCz11, bp)")
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_title("B  Ensembl gene ENSDARG00000058394 'tagln3b'\ncontains the abhd10b ORF as transcript -201",fontsize=10)
ax.ticklabel_format(style="plain",axis="x"); ax.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=7)
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---- Panel C: presequence features ----
M=pd.read_csv("mts_features.csv")
ax=axes[2]
x=np.arange(len(M)); w=0.27
ax.bar(x-w,M.net,w,label="net charge (R+K) - (D+E), first 45 aa",color="#4c72b0")
ax.bar(x,M.acidic_DE,w,label="acidic residues D+E",color="#c44e52")
ax.bar(x+w,M.maxMuH18*4,w,label="max hydrophobic moment x4 (18-aa window)",color="#55a868")
ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([p.replace(" (","\n(") for p in M.protein],rotation=30,ha="right",fontsize=7)
ax.set_title("C  Mitochondrial presequence features\nabhd10a 5' end is ambiguous between two isoforms",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc="upper left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
